name: Stormbringer: Storm Synergy lets Electrocute run through Stormflow and apply Conductive (#1360)
contract: #1360: Storm Synergy (578300) reads 'Your Electrocute can now be used while channeling Stormflow and causes it to apply Conductive'. Neither clause is delivered. Clause A: the core's only 'cast while channeling' gate is Unit::CanCastDuringChannel (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp), consulted by Unit::SetCurrentCastedSpell, which otherwise calls InterruptSpell(CURRENT_CHANNELED_SPELL); it whitelists Tinker, Cultist, Starcaller, Necromancer, Demon Hunter and Witch Doctor and had no CLASS_STORMBRINGER branch. Stormflow's own allow-list is its Effect[1] aura 353, whose handler slot is 'nullptr' (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:418), and its class mask (6144, 128, 128) covers Shock (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2048) and Brine (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 128) but not Electrocute (33554432, 2097152, 32). Clause B: 578300 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 567559 with ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp:2257) and Conductive is never cast. Conductive 567559 has DurationIndex 9 = 30000 ms and all three effects on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER. Ranks used are the ones a level-80 Stormbringer owns: Stormflow 572867 (from level 68) and Electrocute 501432 (from level 80). Electrocute has CastingTimeIndex 1 = 0 ms, so it is instant with or without the fix and its cast time is not a discriminator; the discriminators are that the channel survives and that Conductive appears. The dummy is dropped below 35 % health because Electrocute's own description restricts it to enemies below 35 % health. Postfix debug (this session): the DISCRIMINATING Electrocute cast is protocol cast #4 in this scenario (Stormflow, Electrocute, Stormflow, Electrocute); result.json's cast_failures reports cast_count 4 for spell 501432 with reason 67 (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY, SharedDefines.h) -- the second Stormflow cast's own 1.5 s GCD had not fully cleared after only a 1500 ms wait, so the discriminating Electrocute cast was rejected server-side before Unit::CanCastDuringChannel or the Conductive OnSpellHitResult hook ever ran. The 'Electrocute landed' spell_damage_count assertion still passed because it is not scoped to a time window and was satisfied by the earlier, successful BASELINE Electrocute hit against the same dummy. Same shared-GCD pattern already fixed today for stormbringer-fix-static-electricity.json (commit 3c13018f3) and the Evergale cluster (commit dc8290b7f).
